newsitem.title: USA: Ex Credit Suisse North America executive sentenced.
newsitem.headline: Ex Credit Suisse North America executive sentenced.

text.p: A former deputy regional head for North America for Credit Suisse Bank has been sentenced to one year and a day in prison for embezzlement from the bank, federal prosecutors said Monday.
Peter Nardin, 49, of Greenwich, Conn., had pleaded guilty in April to embezzling $331,000 from his employer. He was sentenced Friday by U.S. District Judge John Keenan.
He had admitted that he diverted the money over a 15-month period from August 1994 and November 1995 from a Credit Suisse account into his personal bank account.
